links.comparator_used: Zero-shot baseline prompt without uncertainty-acknowledgment or refusal encouragement, compared with 3 prompt formats including a patient safety-focused mitigation prompt
links.outcome: Refusal Index (alignment between refusal behavior and likelihood of error)
links.effect: RI ranged 0.104-0.574 across models (weak to moderate alignment). Mitigation prompts had inconsistent effects on RI and did not reliably recalibrate uncertainty behavior. Qwen3-32B and GPT-4o-mini increased refusal rates under mitigation prompting.
links.tradeoff: Refusals increased under mitigation prompting but not in cases where responses were more likely to be incorrect, so extra refusals were not well targeted at errors.
links.quote: Prompt-based mitigation strategies produced inconsistent effects on RI and did not reliably recalibrate uncertainty behavior.
